bio: Kathryn Sikkink is the Ryan Family Professor of Human Rights Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and an affiliated faculty member at the Harvard Government Department and the Harvard Law School. She is an International Relations scholar best known for her work on human rights, international norms and law, transnational advocacy networks, and transitional justice.
